purpose: Full official T2I-CompBench++ prompt population with ten paired independent image seeds per prompt.

population.selection_policy: all official prompts in source order

interpretation.unit_of_pairing: identical category, official prompt position, and image seed across all arms
interpretation.unit_of_resampling: prompt after averaging its ten image scores
interpretation.reason: categories use different official automatic metrics

change_policy: Do not edit files in place. Any changed prompt, position, seed, source pin, or interpretation requires a new dataset id or version.
